scope: Source implementation, local verification/builds and integration into recorded branches; no operating server or game installation changes.
distributionScope: No JARs committed. Full authoring originals are archived only in the private resourcepack repository, outside the public resource_pack game directory.

entries.licenseScope: Mod itself; bundled dependencies retain their own licenses and prior provenance. No existing notices removed.

licenseNotices.byteSource: Pinned source Git blob; checkout line endings may differ.

artifactInspection.baselineProvenance: Existing local build output captured before this implementation; not claimed to be a freshly rebuilt baseline.

entries.binaryLicense: MIT (compiled mod source; existing metadata placeholder retained)
entries.licenseScope: Mod itself; bundled dependencies retain their own licenses and prior provenance. No existing notices removed.

licenseNotices.byteSource: Pinned source Git blob; checkout line endings may differ.

artifactInspection.baselineProvenance: Existing local build output captured before implementation; older than the preceding source pin and not freshly rebuilt.

resourcepack.licenseScope: Existing owner-authorized game files only. Full design/editor originals remain private and excluded from public packaging; existing copyrights preserved.
resourcepack.authoringPolicy: Exact baseline Git blob bytes; original Windows CRLF checkout hash/size retained separately.

localGameFilesZipComparison.byteSource: Raw Git blob bytes for both source commits via cat-file --batch, without checkout/archive attribute conversion.
localGameFilesZipComparison.zipScope: Deterministic resource_pack game files only, DEFLATE default compression, fixed 1980 timestamp and sorted names; excludes additional release notices/metadata. This is a local packaging comparison, not network measurement.

archiveExportGameFilesZipComparison.zipScope: Deterministic resource_pack game files only, deflate default; excludes additional release notices/metadata. This is a local packaging comparison, not network measurement.
archiveExportGameFilesZipComparison.byteSource: Baseline Git archive/export representation matches captured Windows CRLF model bytes; final archive/export representation matches runtime files. This differs from raw Git blob bytes.

oritechInventory.platform: Actual production and frozen pre-change Java sources with platform doubles; real Minecraft/Fabric compile and remap checked separately.

warmAllocationWorkload.scope: Platform-double construction counters after reuse warmup, not measured CPU time or heap/GC. First use retains scoped inventories.

chiselsandbits.scope: Actual cache/DataAware factory/Chiseled and Combined model/real NBT/BakedQuad arrays; registry/config fixtures; no client/OpenGL.

independentReadOnlyReviews: Resourcepack parser/export and source preservation contracts

limitations: No live game/client/OpenGL or real performance/network measurements; geometry/UV/lighting/parser and recipe behavior are validated by deterministic contracts and builds.
The 64 MiB estimate excludes shared textures/native/JVM overhead and other model caches; it is not a total heap or VRAM cap. Bypassed/evicted entries can incur rebuilding CPU cost.

Historical baseline JARs were captured before implementation, not freshly rebuilt. The C&B local baseline predates its preceding source pin; JAR class differences can include older work/compiler effects.
C&B preserves the existing Fabric @license@ placeholder and existing absence of license/notice filenames in its mod containers; source MIT and dependency provenance remain separately recorded.
The ZIP comparison uses deterministic resource_pack files only, excluding extra release metadata/notices; it is not an actual release or measured server bandwidth reduction.
This phase changes no packet format, request rate or game resolution/options. Server RX and GPU load reduction are not established.
